title: Integrating-factor identity for the radial first-variation equation
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (I I' E Q a : ℝ → ℝ) (R M β : ℝ), β < 1 → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, HasDerivAt I (I' t) t) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, ContinuousAt E t) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, ContinuousAt Q t) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, 0 ≤ I t) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, (n : ℝ) * I t - t * I' t + t * Q t = -E t) → (∀ t, a t = E t / t ^ (n + 1) / (1 + I t / t ^ n)) → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, |a t| ≤ M * t ^ (-β)) → ∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r < R → Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..r, a τ) * (1 + I r / r ^ n) - Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..s, a τ) * (1 + I s / s ^ n) = ∫ t in s..r, Real.exp (-∫ τ in (0)..t, a τ) * (Q t / t ^ n)
